sourceDate.text: 十九年（本章承上至正十七年；曆事應屬元世祖至元。《元史》卷164郭守敬傳作十九年；王恂傳在十八年居父喪後記未幾卒。《元名臣事略》卷9王恂提要作十七年曆成之又明年，即十八年。十八、十九年為競爭讀法，未選定其中一年。）

claims.event: Wang Xun's death is explicit in s0012; its exact year is uncertain between competing Zhiyuan 18 and 19 witnesses. Both alternatives fall within absolute Western year bounds AD 1281-1283: year 18 begins in AD 1281 and year 19 ends before year 20 begins in early AD 1283. This is an enclosing bound for one death event, not selection of either regnal year, a continuous activity interval, or a third source claim that he died in year 20.

sourceDate.text: 至正十七年（本章原文；據《元史》卷52至元條及卷164王恂、郭守敬傳，所指為元世祖至元十七年。卷52另記十七年冬至曆成，十八年頒行天下。）

claims.event: Wang Xun's participation in completion of the Shoushi calendar, corroborated by Yuan shi 52 and his biography in Yuan shi 164. AD 1280 is the conventional label of Yuan Shizu's Zhiyuan 17, not a Gregorian month/day conversion and not the later completion of the two-fascicle ready reckoners.

claims.assessment: methods founded on right-triangle and arc-versine geometry, finer than antiquity

statement.en: Titles of his calendar works can be traced in his biography.

units.zh: 志第十 歷四
units.en: Treatise Ten: Calendrics, Part Four.
units.literal: Treatise 10, Calendar 4.

units.zh: 大統曆法二立成
units.en: Grand Concordance Calendar Method, Part Two: Ready Reckoners.
units.literal: Grand Concordance Calendar Method Two: Ready Reckoners.

units.zh: 立成者，以日月五星盈縮遲疾之數，預爲排定，以便推步取用也。
units.en: Ready reckoners tabulate the expansion–contraction and slow–rapid values of the sun, moon, and five planets in advance, arranged for ready retrieval in stepwise computation.
units.literal: Ready reckoners: using the numbers of expansion-contraction and slow-rapid for sun, moon, and five stars, pre-arranged in tables for convenient use in stepwise computation.

units.zh: 《元志》、《曆經》步七政盈縮遲疾，皆有二術。
units.en: In the Yuan History and the Calendar Classic, the procedures for the seven regulators' expansion–contraction and slow–rapid motion each take two forms.
units.literal: The Yuan History and Calendar Classic, in stepping the seven regulators' expansion-contraction and slow-rapid, each have two procedures.

units.zh: 其一術以三差立算者，即 布立成法也。
units.en: One establishes the calculation through the three differences—this is the arrayed ready-reckoner method.
units.literal: One procedure establishes calculation by the three differences—this is the arrayed ready-reckoner method.

units.zh: 其又術雲，以其下盈縮分，乘入限分萬約之，以加其下盈縮積者，用立成法也。
units.en: The other reads: multiply the underlying expansion–contraction increment by the degrees entered into the limit, scale by ten thousand, and add it to the underlying expansion–contraction accumulation—this is the ready-reckoner method.
units.literal: The other procedure says: multiply the expansion-contraction portion below by the entry-limit portion, reduce by ten thousand, add to the expansion-contraction accumulation below—the ready-reckoner method is used.

units.zh: 而遣立成未載，無從入算。
units.en: Yet the transmitted ready reckoners were never recorded, leaving no basis for the calculation.
units.literal: Yet the transmitted ready reckoners were not recorded—there is no basis for entering the calculation.

units.zh: 今依《大統歷通軌》具錄之。
units.en: They are reproduced here in full from the Comprehensive Track of the Grand Concordance Calendar.
units.literal: Now according to the Comprehensive Track of the Grand Concordance Calendar, fully recorded.

units.zh: 其目四：曰太陽盈縮，曰晨昏分，曰太陰遲疾，曰五星盈縮。
units.en: There are four sections: solar expansion–contraction, morning and evening divisions, lunar slow–rapid motion, and planetary expansion–contraction.
units.literal: Its sections are four: called solar expansion-contraction, morning-evening divisions, lunar slow-rapid, five stars' expansion-contraction.

units.zh: 餘詳《法原》及《推步》卷中。
units.en: Further particulars appear in Origins of the Method and in the Stepwise Computation fascicle.
units.literal: The remainder is detailed in Origins of Methods and in the Stepwise Computation juan.

units.zh: 按《元史》，至正十七年《授時曆》成。
units.en: Note: According to the Yuan History, the Season Granting Calendar was completed in the seventeenth year of Zhizheng.
units.literal: Commentary: According to the Yuan History, in the seventeenth year of Zhizheng the Season Granting Calendar was completed.

units.zh: 十九年王恂卒，時歷雖頒，然立成之數尚皆有定藁。
units.en: Wang Xun died in the nineteenth year. The calendar had been promulgated, but the ready-reckoner constants still existed only as settled drafts.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year Wang Xun died; though the calendar had been promulgated, the ready-reckoner numbers still all had fixed drafts.

units.zh: 郭守敬比類編次，整齊分秒，裁爲二卷。
units.en: Guo Shoujing drew analogies among the drafts, harmonized the minutes and seconds, and reduced the work to two fascicles.
units.literal: Guo Shoujing drew analogies to arrange and compile, aligned fen and miao, trimmed to two juan.

units.zh: 而今欽天監本，載嘉議大夫太史令臣王恂奉敕撰。
units.en: The Imperial Astronomical Bureau edition now in use, however, credits Raised-Proposal Grandee and Grand Astrologer Wang Xun as having composed it by imperial commission.
units.literal: Yet the present Imperial Astronomical Bureau edition records: Raised-Proposal Grandee, Director of the Astronomy Bureau, Wang Xun, subject commissioned to compile by imperial edict.

units.zh: 意者王先有藁，而郭卒成之歟？
units.en: Perhaps Wang prepared the drafts and Guo brought them to completion?
units.literal: Perhaps Wang had drafts first, and Guo completed them in the end?

units.zh: 太陽盈初縮末限立成冬至前後二象限同用
units.en: Ready reckoners for the solar expansion-initial and contraction-final interval: the two quadrants before and after the winter solstice share the same table.
units.literal: Solar expansion-initial contraction-final limit ready reckoners: two quadrants before and after winter solstice used alike.

units.zh: 表格略
units.en: [Table omitted.]
units.literal: Table abbreviated.

units.zh: 晨分加二百五十分，爲日出分。
units.en: Add 250 parts to the morning division to obtain the sunrise division.
units.literal: Add 250 fen to morning division to obtain sunrise division.

units.zh: 日週一萬分，內減晨分爲昏分。
units.en: From the solar circuit of 10,000 parts, subtract the morning division to obtain the evening division.
units.literal: Solar circuit 10,000 fen; subtract morning division within to obtain evening division.

units.zh: 昏分減二百五十分，爲日入分，又減五千分，爲半晝分。
units.en: Subtract 250 parts from the evening division for sunset, and a further 5,000 parts for half-daylight.
units.literal: Evening division minus 250 fen is sunset division; again minus 5,000 fen is half-daylight division.

units.zh: 故立成只列晨昏分，則出入及半晝分皆具，不必盡列也。
units.en: The ready reckoners therefore list only the morning and evening divisions; sunrise, sunset, and half-daylight follow from them without need for separate columns.
units.literal: Therefore the ready reckoners list only morning-evening divisions—then sunrise-sunset and half-daylight are all present; there is no need to list them all.

units.zh: 以下表格略
units.en: [Tables below omitted.]
units.literal: Below, tables abbreviated.

units.zh: 復諭贊善王恂曰：「省臣所啟，等國事也。
units.en: He also told his tutor Wang Xun, "What the Secretariat ministers report is state business.
units.literal: He also instructed the tutor Wang Xun: "What the provincial ministers report is equal to state affairs.

units.zh: 至王恂陳說尤多，事見恂傳。
units.en: Wang Xun spoke at even greater length; see his biography for the details.
units.literal: As for Wang Xun, his statements were especially numerous; the matter is seen in Xun's biography.

units.zh: 每與諸王近臣習射之暇，輒講論經典，若《資治通鑒》、《貞觀政要》，王恂、許衡所述遼、金帝王行事要略，下至《武經》等書，從容片言之間，茍有允愜，未嘗不為之灑然改容。
units.en: In intervals from archery practice with the princes and close ministers, he would discuss the classics, from Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance and Essentials of Government in the Zhenguan Reign to Wang Xun and Xu Heng's summaries of Liao and Jin rulers and even Military Classics. An apt remark would always make him brighten visibly.
units.literal: Whenever he had leisure from practicing archery with the princes and close ministers, he would discuss the classics — such as Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, Essentials of Government in the Zhenguan Reign, the summaries of Liao and Jin imperial conduct narrated by Wang Xun and Xu Heng, down to books such as Military Classics — and in a relaxed remark, if anything was apt and pleasing, he never failed to change expression with sudden clarity.

units.zh: 時侍經幄者，如王恂、白棟皆朝夕不出東宮，而待制李謙、太常宋瑽尤加咨訪，蓋無間也。
units.en: Those who attended his study sessions, such as Wang Xun and Bai Dong, scarcely left the Eastern Palace from morning to night, while Awaiting Draft Li Qian and Director of Ceremonies Song Cong were consulted especially often.
units.literal: Those who attended the classics curtain at the time, such as Wang Xun and Bai Dong, morning and evening did not leave the Eastern Palace; while Awaiting Draft Li Qian and Director of Ceremonies Song Cong were especially consulted — there was virtually no interval.

units.zh: 郭守敬、齊履謙傳中，有書名可考。
units.en: Titles of those works can still be traced in the biographies of Guo Shoujing and Qi Lüqian.
units.literal: In the biographies of Guo Shoujing and Qi Lüqian, book titles may be examined.

units.zh: 按郭敬創法五端，內一曰黃道差，此其根率也。
units.en: Commentary: Guo Shoujing established five methods; ecliptic difference is one of them, and these are its fundamental rates.
units.literal: Commentary: Guo Shoujing established five methods, of which one is ecliptic difference—this is its root rate.

units.zh: 《授時》立術，以句股、弧矢、方圓、斜直所容，求其數差，合於渾象之理，視古爲密。
units.en: The Season Granting calendar established its procedure through right-triangle, arc-versine, circle–square, and oblique–rectilinear relations to derive the numerical differences—conforming to the armillary model and finer than antiquity.
units.literal: The Season Granting system established its procedure using what is contained by legs-and-hypotenuse, arc-versine, square-and-circle, and oblique-and-straight relations to seek the numerical differences, matching the logic of the armillary sphere and tighter than antiquity.

units.zh: 《元史》漫無採摭，僅存李謙之《議祿》、《曆經》之初稿。
units.en: The Yuan History excerpts almost nothing; only Li Qian's draft Discourse on Official Emoluments and Calendar Classic remains.
units.literal: The Yuan History excerpts almost nothing at random; only the draft of Li Qian's Discourse on Emoluments and Calendar Classic survives.

units.zh: 顧《至元曆經》所載略，又誤以黃道矢度爲積差，黃道矢差爲率，今正之。
units.en: Yet the Calendar Classic of the Zhiyuan reign records only an abridgment and also mistakenly treated ecliptic versine degrees as accumulated difference and ecliptic versine difference as rate—here corrected.
units.literal: Yet what the Zhiyuan Calendar Classic records is abbreviated, and it also wrongly took ecliptic versine degrees as accumulated difference and ecliptic versine difference as rate—here corrected.

units.zh: 《授時曆》以測算術爲宗，惟求合天，不牽合律呂、卦爻。
units.en: The Season Granting Calendar takes observational computation as its foundation, seeking only agreement with the heavens and not forcing alignment with pitch-pipes or hexagram lines.
units.literal: The Season Granting Calendar takes measurement-and-computation as its master, only seeking agreement with heaven, not yoked to pitch-pipes or hexagram lines.
